mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie_agg) AS movie_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movie_agg WHERE rating_count > 0) AS rated_movie_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rating_count), 0) FROM movie_agg) AS rating_count, (SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(avg_score * rating_count), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(rating_count), 0), 2) FROM movie_agg) AS avg_score, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(rating_count), 0) FROM movie_agg) AS max_rating_count, (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) FROM fact_rating r JOIN movie_agg ma ON ma.movie_id = r.movie_id WHERE r.rated_date >= #{from} AND r.rated_date <= #{to}) AS high_score_ratio

SELECT
r.rated_date r.rated_month AS period, COUNT(*) AS rating_count, ROUND(AVG(r.score), 2) AS avg_score FROM fact_rating r JOIN movie_agg ma ON ma.movie_id = r.movie_id WHERE r.rated_date >= #{from} AND r.rated_date <= #{to} GROUP BY
r.rated_date r.rated_month
ORDER BY period

SELECT g.genre_name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.movie_id) AS movie_count, COALESCE(SUM(ma.rating_count), 0) AS rating_count, ROUND(AVG(ma.avg_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM movie_agg ma JOIN rel_movie_genre rg ON rg.movie_id = ma.movie_id JOIN dim_genre g ON g.genre_id = rg.genre_id GROUP BY g.genre_name ORDER BY movie_count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN avg_score >= 9 THEN '9.0-10' WHEN avg_score >= 8 THEN '8.0-8.9' WHEN avg_score >= 7 THEN '7.0-7.9' WHEN avg_score >= 6 THEN '6.0-6.9' ELSE '0-5.9' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS movie_count FROM movie_agg WHERE rating_count > 0 GROUP BY bucket
SELECT movie_id, title, release_year, rating_count, ROUND(avg_score, 2) AS avg_score FROM movie_agg WHERE rating_count > 0 ORDER BY ${orderBy} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT t.tag AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM fact_tag t JOIN movie_agg ma ON ma.movie_id = t.movie_id GROUP BY t.tag ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FLOOR(ma.release_year / 10) * 10 AS decade, g.genre_name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS movie_count FROM movie_agg ma JOIN rel_movie_genre rg ON rg.movie_id = ma.movie_id JOIN dim_genre g ON g.genre_id = rg.genre_id WHERE ma.release_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FLOOR(ma.release_year / 10) * 10, g.genre_name ORDER BY decade, genre
SELECT genre_id, genre_name, genre_name_en FROM dim_genre ORDER BY sort_no, genre_id
